prompt: Alkoxymercuration-demercuration: 2-methylpropene + methanol, Hg(OAc)2; then NaBH4. Draw the Markovnikov ether.

traps.note: Markovnikov: OMe on more substituted (3°) carbon.

explanation: Methanol attacks the mercurinium at the more substituted carbon (where positive character is highest), giving tert-butyl methyl ether. Williamson can't make this cleanly (3° RX + NaOMe → E2); alkoxymercuration is the preferred route to 3° ethers.
